source: Ask a small question
Instead of starting with a whole life story, ask about one meal, one journey or one place. A short answer is a valuable beginning. Let the storyteller choose what feels comfortable.
draft: Commencez par un repas, un voyage ou un lieu. Une réponse courte suffit. Laissez chacun choisir ce qu’il souhaite raconter.

source: Keep uncertainty honest
Old photographs rarely come with perfect dates. LifeTalea accepts a year, month, exact date or unknown date. You can add a location yourself without granting location access.
draft: LifeTalea accepte une année, un mois, une date précise ou une date inconnue. Vous pouvez saisir un lieu sans autoriser la géolocalisation.

source: Preserve a second copy
Local storage keeps memories close, but a device can be lost. Export a backup and keep it in a location you control. Check the archive before deleting an original.
draft: Un appareil peut se perdre. Exportez une sauvegarde vers un emplacement que vous contrôlez et vérifiez-la avant de supprimer l’original.

source: Make room for their voice
draft: Gardez une place pour leur voix

source: Capture the pauses, laughter and familiar expressions that a written story cannot always hold.
draft: Préservez les rires, les silences et les expressions familières qu’un texte ne peut pas toujours transmettre.

source: Record with care
Ask the speaker’s permission. Find a quiet space and make a short test recording. Save a memory first, then choose Record a story. Pause or resume whenever you need.
draft: Demandez l’accord de la personne et faites un essai au calme. Enregistrez d’abord le souvenir, puis lancez le récit audio. Vous pouvez mettre en pause et reprendre.

source: On your device

LifeTalea saves AAC audio in M4A files in private app storage. Leaving the app stops and saves the recording. Free recordings are limited to three minutes; Premium extends that limit, subject to storage.
draft: LifeTalea conserve les enregistrements AAC dans des fichiers M4A privés. Quitter l’application arrête et sauvegarde l’audio. La limite gratuite est de trois minutes ; Premium la prolonge selon l’espace disponible.

source: Check your tablet
Recording requires a working microphone and permission. Speech commands use an installed recognition service and may not be available on Fire tablets. Touch controls remain available.
draft: L’enregistrement nécessite un microphone fonctionnel et son autorisation. Les commandes vocales dépendent d’un service installé, parfois absent sur les tablettes Fire. Les boutons tactiles restent disponibles.

source: A written companion to a spoken memory
draft: Ajoutez du texte à vos souvenirs audio

source: Create a draft from this recording on your device. No audio is uploaded. Choose the spoken language, then confirm. Recordings up to ten minutes are supported. Processing may be slow; check the draft for mistakes before saving.
draft: Créez un brouillon à partir de cet enregistrement sur votre appareil. Aucun fichier audio n’est envoyé. Choisissez la langue parlée, puis confirmez. Durée maximale : dix minutes. Le traitement peut être lent ; vérifiez le texte avant de l’enregistrer.

source: What works today
Open a memory and edit its transcript field. You can type a transcript or paste text you already have. Corrections are stored locally beside the original recording.
draft: Ouvrez un souvenir pour saisir ou coller sa transcription. Les corrections sont conservées sur l’appareil, à côté de l’enregistrement original.

source: Review transcript draft
Transcribe recordings up to ten minutes long. Longer recordings are safe and can have a manually entered transcript.
draft: La transcription est limitée à dix minutes. Les enregistrements plus longs sont conservés ; vous pouvez saisir leur transcription.

source: Separate services
Android speech recognition for commands is different from transcribing a saved recording. A device having one capability does not establish support for the other.
draft: La reconnaissance des commandes vocales Android ne transcrit pas les fichiers enregistrés. La présence de l’une ne garantit pas la disponibilité de l’autre.

source: Turn a collection into a chapter
draft: Faites de vos souvenirs un nouveau chapitre

source: Bring written memories and photographs into saved scrapbook drafts.
draft: Rassemblez vos récits et vos photos dans des brouillons de livres conservés sur votre appareil.

source: Choose the moments
Create a scrapbook and choose memories from your library. Each page refers to a saved memory, keeping its story and photographs together.
draft: Créez un livre à partir de votre bibliothèque. Chaque page renvoie à un souvenir enregistré et conserve le lien entre son récit et ses photos.

source: Find the right rhythm
Move pages up or down, select a story or photograph layout, and add a caption. Save your captions before previewing. A deleted source memory is clearly marked so you can repair the draft.
draft: Réorganisez les pages, choisissez une mise en page et enregistrez vos légendes avant l’aperçu. Les souvenirs supprimés sont signalés pour vous permettre de corriger le brouillon.

source: Keep it private
Scrapbook drafts are local. Creating a scrapbook never publishes it. Review any exported document before you decide to share it.
draft: Créer un livre ne le publie pas. Les brouillons restent locaux ; vérifiez tout document exporté avant de le partager.

source: Remember how the chapters connect
draft: Retrouvez le fil de votre histoire

source: Explore saved memories in date order, including those with approximate and unknown dates.
draft: Parcourez vos souvenirs dans l’ordre des dates, y compris ceux dont la date est approximative ou inconnue.

source: Follow the years
The timeline sorts known dates from newest to oldest and places undated stories afterwards. Search for a phrase, select an album or filter by year.
draft: Les dates connues vont de la plus récente à la plus ancienne, suivies des récits non datés. Recherchez un mot, un album ou une année.

source: A date can change
Family research often reveals a new detail. Edit the event date and precision in the memory editor; the timeline uses the updated information.
draft: Une recherche familiale peut apporter une précision. Modifiez la date du souvenir et son degré de précision pour mettre à jour la chronologie.

source: No invented history
The timeline uses only stories you save. LifeTalea does not populate your library with fabricated family events.
draft: La chronologie contient uniquement vos souvenirs enregistrés. LifeTalea n’ajoute aucun événement familial fictif à votre bibliothèque.

source: A keepsake to hold onto
draft: Un livre de souvenirs à garder

source: Create a local PDF from a scrapbook’s selected memories, photographs and captions.
draft: Créez sur votre appareil un PDF réunissant les souvenirs, les photos et les légendes de votre livre.

source: Choose what to include
Give the book a cover title. Select A4 or Letter paper. Locations and transcripts are excluded by default and can be included when appropriate.
draft: Ajoutez un titre de couverture et choisissez le format A4 ou Letter. Les lieux et les transcriptions sont exclus par défaut ; vous pouvez les inclure.

source: Review before sharing

PDFs are generated on the device through Android’s PDF API. Long stories continue onto extra pages. Audio is not embedded in printed keepsakes. Review typography and photographs in your PDF viewer before printing.
draft: Le PDF est créé sur l’appareil avec Android. Les longs récits continuent sur plusieurs pages ; l’audio n’est pas intégré. Vérifiez le texte et les photos avant impression.

source: Development status
This feature requires LifeTalea Premium. PDF generation happens on your device. Review the file before sharing. Recordings are not embedded in printed keepsakes.
draft: Cette fonction nécessite LifeTalea Premium. Le PDF est créé sur votre appareil. Vérifiez-le avant de le partager. Les enregistrements audio ne sont pas intégrés au livre imprimé.

source: Your memories, even without a connection
LifeTalea is designed around local storage and touch controls, without a mandatory account.
draft: LifeTalea privilégie le stockage local et les commandes tactiles, sans compte obligatoire.

source: Keep creating offline
Written memories, albums, imported photographs, saved recordings, timeline browsing and scrapbook drafts use local data. PDF generation does not require an external document service.
draft: Récits, albums, photos importées, enregistrements, chronologie et brouillons utilisent des données locales. La création de PDF ne dépend pas d’un service de documents externe.

source: Know the boundaries

Push to talk uses your device’s speech service, which may need internet and process speech externally. Only continue if you agree. Audio commands are not saved by LifeTalea. Command phrases currently support English. Create a draft from this recording on your device. No audio is uploaded. Choose the spoken language, then confirm. Recordings up to ten minutes are supported. Processing may be slow; check the draft for mistakes before saving.
draft: Le mode appuyer pour parler utilise le service vocal de votre appareil. Ce service peut nécessiter Internet et traiter votre voix en dehors de l’appareil. Continuez uniquement si vous êtes d’accord. LifeTalea n’enregistre pas les commandes audio. Les commandes sont actuellement disponibles uniquement en anglais. Créez un brouillon à partir de cet enregistrement sur votre appareil. Aucun fichier audio n’est envoyé. Choisissez la langue parlée, puis confirmez. Durée maximale : dix minutes. Le traitement peut être lent ; vérifiez le texte avant de l’enregistrer.

source: Backups are your choice
Use the document picker to save an archive where you choose. If you select a cloud-backed document provider, that provider handles the exported file under its own privacy terms.
draft: Sélectionnez l’emplacement d’exportation. Si vous choisissez un fournisseur de documents cloud, celui-ci gère le fichier selon ses propres règles de confidentialité.

source: Built with Fire tablets in mind
A native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose application with no required Google Play Services.
draft: Une application native en Kotlin et Jetpack Compose, sans dépendance obligatoire aux services Google Play.

source: Target platform
The minimum supported Android API is 26. This is a technical minimum, not a promise that every device is certified. Fire TV remote navigation is outside the current scope.
draft: L’API Android minimale est 26 ; cela ne certifie pas tous les appareils. La navigation à la télécommande sur Fire TV ne fait pas partie de cette version.

source: Device testing

A connected KFTRWI device reporting Android API 28 is available for development testing. The release report records actual tests; additional Fire sizes and operating-system versions remain to be checked.
draft: Les tests de développement utilisent une tablette KFTRWI sous l’API Android 28. Le rapport décrit les tests réalisés ; d’autres tailles et versions Fire restent à vérifier.

source: Voice varies by device

A microphone supports recording only when permission and hardware are available. Recognition and spoken feedback also need compatible installed services. Touch and text alternatives are always part of the design.
draft: L’enregistrement nécessite un microphone autorisé et fonctionnel. Reconnaissance et lecture vocales exigent des services compatibles. Des alternatives tactiles et textuelles sont prévues.

source: A journal that can feel like home
Choose a language or follow your device settings. Your stories are not translated.
draft: Choisissez une langue ou utilisez celle de l’appareil. Vos récits ne sont pas traduits.

source: The language plan
Targets include regional English, Spanish, French and Portuguese, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Japanese, Hindi, Arabic, Turkish, Indonesian, Korean and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
draft: Anglais, espagnol, français, portugais, allemand, italien, néerlandais, polonais, suédois, japonais, hindi, arabe, turc, indonésien, coréen et chinois simplifié et traditionnel, avec des variantes régionales.

source: Quality before a language claim

Translations must pass placeholder checks, layout tests and review. Store languages, app languages, distribution countries, speech recognition, spoken feedback and transcription each have separate support matrices.
draft: Les traductions exigent des contrôles de variables, de mise en page et de langue. Les langues de l’application, du store et des services vocaux ont chacune leur propre périmètre.

source: Your words stay yours
Changing the interface language does not translate personal memories or recordings. Unreviewed website translations are available in local preview only; production requires review.
draft: Changer la langue ne traduit ni vos récits ni vos enregistrements. Les traductions web non révisées restent limitées à l’aperçu local.

source: Keep the memories. Choose the extras.
draft: Gardez les souvenirs. Choisissez les options.

source: Free: three albums, photographs, written stories, timeline and recordings up to three minutes. No limit on saved written memories.
draft: Gratuit : trois albums, photos, récits, chronologie et enregistrements de trois minutes maximum. Le nombre de récits écrits enregistrés est illimité.

source: Free
Up to three albums, written memories, photographs, a timeline, scrapbook drafts and voice recordings up to three minutes. Saved written memories are not capped.
draft: Trois albums, récits écrits sans limite de nombre, photos, chronologie, brouillons de livres et enregistrements de trois minutes maximum.

source: LifeTalea Premium
One purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, keepsake PDF exports and encrypted local backups. Your existing memories always stay accessible.
draft: Un achat unique pour des albums illimités, des enregistrements plus longs, l’export PDF et les sauvegardes locales chiffrées. Vos souvenirs existants restent accessibles.

source: Your existing stories remain accessible
Premium availability does not lock you out of existing memories. Basic backup and restore remain available. Cloud transcription with ongoing costs is not included in a one-time price promise.
draft: La disponibilité de Premium ne bloque pas vos souvenirs existants. La sauvegarde et la restauration de base restent disponibles. Aucun service cloud de transcription à coût récurrent n’est promis.

source: A few things worth knowing
Practical answers about privacy, recordings, family stories and local preservation.
draft: Des réponses pratiques sur la confidentialité, les enregistrements et la préservation des récits familiaux.

source: Do I need an account?
Core local features require no LifeTalea account. Amazon purchasing uses the account and services provided by the Amazon Appstore.
draft: Les fonctions locales ne nécessitent pas de compte LifeTalea. Les achats utilisent le compte et les services de l’Amazon Appstore.

source: How do I organise old photographs?
Begin with a small album and one photograph. Add names and context you know, use approximate dates when needed, and ask a relative about one detail at a time.
draft: Commencez par un petit album et une photo. Ajoutez les noms et détails connus, indiquez une date approximative et posez une question à la fois à vos proches.

source: Can I record my parents’ life stories?
Yes, with their permission and a compatible microphone. Start with a brief topic and check playback. Do not rely on a single device as your only copy.
draft: Oui, avec leur accord et un microphone compatible. Choisissez un sujet court et vérifiez la lecture. Ne conservez pas votre seule copie sur un seul appareil.

source: Can I transcribe recordings?

Create a draft from this recording on your device. No audio is uploaded. Choose the spoken language, then confirm. Recordings up to ten minutes are supported. Processing may be slow; check the draft for mistakes before saving.
draft: Créez un brouillon à partir de cet enregistrement sur votre appareil. Aucun fichier audio n’est envoyé. Choisissez la langue parlée, puis confirmez. Durée maximale : dix minutes. Le traitement peut être lent ; vérifiez le texte avant de l’enregistrer.

source: Does LifeTalea sync between devices?
No cloud sync is implemented. Local archive export and restore are the preservation tools currently provided.
draft: La synchronisation cloud n’est pas implémentée. Vous pouvez exporter et restaurer des archives locales.

source: Privacy starts with where a story lives
draft: La confidentialité commence là où vivent vos récits

source: Development privacy notice from O.Bankole. Contact banksmi@mail.com. Legal review remains required before public release.
draft: Avis de confidentialité de développement d’O.Bankole. Contact : banksmi@mail.com. Une révision juridique est requise avant publication.

source: Memories and media

Stories, transcripts, photographs, audio and scrapbook drafts stay in private app storage by default. LifeTalea does not require an account, collect location automatically or include advertising and analytics SDKs. Android automatic backup is disabled.
draft: Par défaut, récits, transcriptions, photos, audio et brouillons restent dans le stockage privé. LifeTalea ne demande pas de compte, ne relève pas automatiquement votre position et n’intègre aucun SDK publicitaire ou analytique. La sauvegarde Android est désactivée.

source: Choices that involve other services

Speech recognition uses your installed speech service, which may process speech over a network. It is activated only through push-to-talk with a disclosure. Amazon purchasing communicates with Amazon. Exporting to a cloud document provider shares the selected archive with that provider.

Amazon purchases send app-specific Amazon user and receipt identifiers to LifeTalea’s Supabase-hosted verifier and Amazon. Providers may retain request and connection logs. Stories, photos and recordings are not sent for verification. Saved-recording transcription runs on this device. Exported files must be deleted separately.

Optional daily reminder around 20:00 local time. Delivery may be delayed by device settings. Notifications contain no story content. Off by default.
draft:
La reconnaissance vocale peut traiter la voix en ligne via le service installé, après activation et information. Les achats passent par Amazon. Un export vers un fournisseur cloud lui transmet l’archive choisie.

Les achats Amazon transmettent les identifiants Amazon propres à l’application et les identifiants de reçus au service de vérification de LifeTalea, hébergé par Supabase, et à Amazon. Ces prestataires peuvent conserver des journaux de requêtes et de connexion. Les récits, photos et enregistrements ne sont pas envoyés pour vérification. La transcription des enregistrements s’effectue sur cet appareil. Les fichiers exportés doivent être supprimés séparément.

Rappel quotidien facultatif vers 20 h, heure locale. Les réglages de l’appareil peuvent retarder sa réception. Aucun récit ne figure dans la notification. Désactivé par défaut.

source: Deletion and retention

You can delete individual memories and attachments or all local library data in Settings. Uninstalling removes local app data. Exported files are separate copies that you manage yourself. Purchase records are retained by Amazon under its policies.
draft: Supprimez des éléments ou toute la bibliothèque dans les paramètres. La désinstallation efface les données locales. Vous gérez séparément vos exports ; Amazon conserve les données d’achat selon ses règles.

source: Security limits

Private app storage relies on device protections; the local database does not have a separate application encryption key. Optional encrypted archives use a passphrase. There is no claim of end-to-end encryption or a completed legal compliance assessment.
draft: Le stockage privé repose sur les protections de l’appareil ; la base locale n’a pas de clé de chiffrement propre. Les archives peuvent être chiffrées par phrase secrète. Aucun chiffrement de bout en bout ni conformité juridique complète n’est revendiqué.

source: A little help with your next chapter
draft: Un peu d’aide pour votre prochain chapitre

source: LifeTalea is in development. These steps cover the local tools currently implemented.
draft: LifeTalea est en développement. Ces conseils concernent les outils locaux déjà implémentés.

source: A recording will not start

Check microphone permission and free storage. Save the memory before attaching audio. If recognition is unavailable, use the written controls; speech commands and audio recording are separate capabilities.
draft: Vérifiez l’autorisation du microphone et l’espace disponible. Enregistrez le souvenir avant d’ajouter l’audio. Si la reconnaissance vocale manque, utilisez les boutons : elle est distincte de l’enregistrement.

source: Keep a safe copy
Open Settings, choose whether to include photographs and audio, then Create backup. Store the archive somewhere safe. Restore validates the archive and shows a preview before importing.
draft: Dans les paramètres, choisissez d’inclure ou non les photos et l’audio, puis créez une sauvegarde. Rangez-la en lieu sûr. La restauration valide l’archive et affiche un aperçu avant l’importation.

source: A PDF or archive will not save
draft: Le PDF ou l’archive ne s’enregistre pas

source: Try a writable folder with enough free storage. Check that your chosen document provider is available. A failed export should leave source memories intact.
draft: Choisissez un dossier accessible en écriture avec assez d’espace. Vérifiez le fournisseur de documents. Un échec d’exportation ne doit pas modifier les souvenirs d’origine.

source: Get in touch
Contact O.Bankole for LifeTalea support at banksmi@mail.com.
draft: Pour joindre O.Bankole au sujet de LifeTalea : banksmi@mail.com.

source: Protect your family’s privacy
draft: Protégez la vie privée de votre famille

source: When reporting an issue, describe the device, operating system, app version and steps. Avoid sending private stories, photographs, recordings or backup passphrases.
draft: Décrivez l’appareil, le système, la version de l’application et les étapes du problème. N’envoyez ni récits privés, ni photos, ni enregistrements, ni phrases secrètes de sauvegarde.

Write to banksmi@mail.com.

draft: Ein privater Ort für Fotos, Stimmen und Familiengeschichten. Entdecken Sie die Entwicklungsversion von LifeTalea.

source: A home for the stories behind your photographs
draft: Ein Zuhause für die Geschichten hinter Ihren Fotos

source: Explore the LifeTalea development preview: written memories, private photographs, voice stories, albums and keepsakes.
draft: Entdecken Sie die Entwicklungsversion von LifeTalea: Geschichten, private Fotos, Sprachaufnahmen, Alben und Erinnerungsbücher.

source: Start with one moment
Write a title and a few lines. Add an exact date, an approximate year or no date at all. Tags, favourites and albums help you find the story again.
draft: Ergänzen Sie Titel, Text und ein genaues, ungefähres oder unbekanntes Datum. Schlagwörter, Favoriten und Alben helfen beim Wiederfinden.

source: Photographs and voices, together
Import photographs using your device’s document picker. Record a voice story and keep it beside the written memory. Media is copied into private app storage.
draft: Importieren Sie Fotos über die Dateiauswahl und nehmen Sie eine Geschichte auf. Die Dateien werden in den privaten App-Speicher kopiert.

source: Make a collection your own
One purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, keepsake PDF exports and encrypted local backups. Your existing memories always stay accessible.
draft: Ein Einmalkauf für unbegrenzte Alben, längere Aufnahmen, PDF-Export und verschlüsselte lokale Sicherungen. Vorhandene Erinnerungen bleiben zugänglich.

source: Preserve the details only your family knows
draft: Bewahren Sie die Details, die nur Ihre Familie kennt

source: A family memory journal gives context to photographs: who was there, what happened, and why the moment mattered.
draft: Ein Familientagebuch erklärt, wer auf einem Foto zu sehen ist, was geschah und warum der Moment wichtig war.

source: Ask a small question
Instead of starting with a whole life story, ask about one meal, one journey or one place. A short answer is a valuable beginning. Let the storyteller choose what feels comfortable.
draft: Beginnen Sie mit einem Essen, einer Reise oder einem Ort. Eine kurze Antwort genügt. Jeder entscheidet selbst, was er erzählen möchte.

source: Keep uncertainty honest
Old photographs rarely come with perfect dates. LifeTalea accepts a year, month, exact date or unknown date. You can add a location yourself without granting location access.
draft: LifeTalea akzeptiert Jahr, Monat, genaues oder unbekanntes Datum. Einen Ort können Sie ohne Standortberechtigung selbst eingeben.

source: Preserve a second copy
Local storage keeps memories close, but a device can be lost. Export a backup and keep it in a location you control. Check the archive before deleting an original.
draft: Ein Gerät kann verloren gehen. Exportieren Sie eine Sicherung an einen selbst gewählten Ort und prüfen Sie sie, bevor Sie das Original löschen.

source: Make room for their voice
Capture the pauses, laughter and familiar expressions that a written story cannot always hold.
draft: Halten Sie Pausen, Lachen und vertraute Wendungen fest, die ein Text nicht immer vermitteln kann.

source: Record with care
Ask the speaker’s permission. Find a quiet space and make a short test recording. Save a memory first, then choose Record a story. Pause or resume whenever you need.
draft: Fragen Sie um Erlaubnis und machen Sie eine kurze Probe in ruhiger Umgebung. Speichern Sie zuerst die Erinnerung. Die Aufnahme lässt sich pausieren und fortsetzen.

source: On your device

LifeTalea saves AAC audio in M4A files in private app storage. Leaving the app stops and saves the recording. Free recordings are limited to three minutes; Premium extends that limit, subject to storage.
draft: LifeTalea speichert AAC-Audio in privaten M4A-Dateien. Beim Verlassen der App wird die Aufnahme beendet und gespeichert. Kostenlos sind drei Minuten möglich; Premium verlängert dies bei ausreichendem Speicherplatz.

source: Check your tablet
Recording requires a working microphone and permission. Speech commands use an installed recognition service and may not be available on Fire tablets. Touch controls remain available.
draft: Aufnahmen benötigen ein funktionierendes Mikrofon und die Berechtigung. Sprachbefehle hängen von installierten Diensten ab, die auf Fire-Tablets fehlen können. Touch-Bedienung bleibt verfügbar.

source: A written companion to a spoken memory

Create a draft from this recording on your device. No audio is uploaded. Choose the spoken language, then confirm. Recordings up to ten minutes are supported. Processing may be slow; check the draft for mistakes before saving.
draft: Erstellen Sie auf Ihrem Gerät einen Textentwurf aus dieser Aufnahme. Es wird kein Audio hochgeladen. Wählen Sie die gesprochene Sprache und bestätigen Sie. Aufnahmen dürfen höchstens zehn Minuten lang sein. Die Verarbeitung kann dauern; prüfen Sie den Text vor dem Speichern.

source: What works today
Open a memory and edit its transcript field. You can type a transcript or paste text you already have. Corrections are stored locally beside the original recording.
draft: Öffnen Sie eine Erinnerung und schreiben oder kopieren Sie das Transkript in das Textfeld. Änderungen bleiben lokal bei der Originalaufnahme.

source: Review transcript draft
Transcribe recordings up to ten minutes long. Longer recordings are safe and can have a manually entered transcript.
draft: Die Transkription unterstützt Aufnahmen bis zu zehn Minuten. Längere Aufnahmen bleiben erhalten und können manuell transkribiert werden.

source: Separate services
Android speech recognition for commands is different from transcribing a saved recording. A device having one capability does not establish support for the other.
draft: Die Android-Erkennung von Sprachbefehlen transkribiert keine gespeicherten Dateien. Eine verfügbare Funktion garantiert die andere nicht.

source: Turn a collection into a chapter
draft: Aus Erinnerungen wird ein neues Kapitel

source: Bring written memories and photographs into saved scrapbook drafts.
draft: Fassen Sie Geschichten und Fotos in lokal gespeicherten Buchentwürfen zusammen.

source: Choose the moments
Create a scrapbook and choose memories from your library. Each page refers to a saved memory, keeping its story and photographs together.
draft: Wählen Sie Erinnerungen aus Ihrer Bibliothek für das Buch. Jede Seite verweist auf eine gespeicherte Erinnerung mit Text und Fotos.

source: Find the right rhythm
Move pages up or down, select a story or photograph layout, and add a caption. Save your captions before previewing. A deleted source memory is clearly marked so you can repair the draft.
draft: Ordnen Sie Seiten und Layouts und speichern Sie Bildunterschriften vor der Vorschau. Gelöschte Erinnerungen werden markiert, damit Sie den Entwurf korrigieren können.

source: Keep it private
Scrapbook drafts are local. Creating a scrapbook never publishes it. Review any exported document before you decide to share it.
draft: Ein Buchentwurf wird nicht veröffentlicht. Er bleibt lokal. Prüfen Sie exportierte Dokumente, bevor Sie sie teilen.

source: Remember how the chapters connect
Explore saved memories in date order, including those with approximate and unknown dates.
draft: Durchsuchen Sie Erinnerungen nach Datum, auch mit ungefähren oder unbekannten Angaben.

source: Follow the years
The timeline sorts known dates from newest to oldest and places undated stories afterwards. Search for a phrase, select an album or filter by year.
draft: Bekannte Daten erscheinen vom neuesten zum ältesten, danach folgen undatierte Geschichten. Suchen Sie nach Text, Album oder Jahr.

source: A date can change
Family research often reveals a new detail. Edit the event date and precision in the memory editor; the timeline uses the updated information.
draft: Familienforschung kann neue Details liefern. Ändern Sie Datum und Genauigkeit in der Erinnerung; die Zeitleiste übernimmt die Angaben.

source: No invented history
The timeline uses only stories you save. LifeTalea does not populate your library with fabricated family events.
draft: Die Zeitleiste nutzt nur gespeicherte Erinnerungen. LifeTalea fügt keine erfundenen Familienereignisse hinzu.

source: A keepsake to hold onto
Create a local PDF from a scrapbook’s selected memories, photographs and captions.
draft: Erstellen Sie lokal eine PDF-Datei mit ausgewählten Erinnerungen, Fotos und Bildunterschriften.

source: Choose what to include
Give the book a cover title. Select A4 or Letter paper. Locations and transcripts are excluded by default and can be included when appropriate.
draft: Geben Sie einen Titel an und wählen Sie A4 oder Letter. Orte und Transkripte sind standardmäßig ausgeschlossen und können ergänzt werden.

source: Review before sharing

PDFs are generated on the device through Android’s PDF API. Long stories continue onto extra pages. Audio is not embedded in printed keepsakes. Review typography and photographs in your PDF viewer before printing.
draft: Die PDF-Datei entsteht mit Android auf dem Gerät. Lange Geschichten laufen auf weiteren Seiten weiter; Audio ist nicht eingebettet. Prüfen Sie Text und Fotos vor dem Drucken.

source: Development status
This feature requires LifeTalea Premium. PDF generation happens on your device. Review the file before sharing. Recordings are not embedded in printed keepsakes.
draft: Diese Funktion erfordert LifeTalea Premium. Die PDF-Datei wird auf Ihrem Gerät erstellt. Prüfen Sie sie vor dem Teilen. Audioaufnahmen werden nicht in gedruckte Erinnerungsbücher eingebettet.

source: Your memories, even without a connection
LifeTalea is designed around local storage and touch controls, without a mandatory account.
draft: LifeTalea setzt auf lokalen Speicher und Touch-Bedienung, ohne verpflichtendes Konto.

source: Keep creating offline
Written memories, albums, imported photographs, saved recordings, timeline browsing and scrapbook drafts use local data. PDF generation does not require an external document service.
draft: Geschichten, Alben, importierte Fotos, Aufnahmen, Zeitleiste und Buchentwürfe nutzen lokale Daten. Die PDF-Erstellung benötigt keinen externen Dokumentendienst.

source: Know the boundaries

Push to talk uses your device’s speech service, which may need internet and process speech externally. Only continue if you agree. Audio commands are not saved by LifeTalea. Command phrases currently support English. Create a draft from this recording on your device. No audio is uploaded. Choose the spoken language, then confirm. Recordings up to ten minutes are supported. Processing may be slow; check the draft for mistakes before saving.
draft: Die Sprachfunktion verwendet den Sprachdienst Ihres Geräts. Dieser kann Internet benötigen und Sprache außerhalb des Geräts verarbeiten. Fahren Sie nur fort, wenn Sie damit einverstanden sind. LifeTalea speichert keine Audiobefehle. Sprachbefehle werden derzeit nur auf Englisch unterstützt. Erstellen Sie auf Ihrem Gerät einen Textentwurf aus dieser Aufnahme. Es wird kein Audio hochgeladen. Wählen Sie die gesprochene Sprache und bestätigen Sie. Aufnahmen dürfen höchstens zehn Minuten lang sein. Die Verarbeitung kann dauern; prüfen Sie den Text vor dem Speichern.

source: Backups are your choice
Use the document picker to save an archive where you choose. If you select a cloud-backed document provider, that provider handles the exported file under its own privacy terms.
draft: Wählen Sie den Exportort. Bei einem Cloud-Dokumentenanbieter verarbeitet dieser die exportierte Datei nach seinen eigenen Datenschutzregeln.

source: Built with Fire tablets in mind
A native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose application with no required Google Play Services.
draft: Eine native Anwendung mit Kotlin und Jetpack Compose, ohne erforderliche Google Play-Dienste.

source: Target platform
The minimum supported Android API is 26. This is a technical minimum, not a promise that every device is certified. Fire TV remote navigation is outside the current scope.
draft: Android-API 26 ist die technische Mindestanforderung und keine Zertifizierung aller Geräte. Fire-TV-Fernbedienung wird derzeit nicht unterstützt.

source: Device testing

A connected KFTRWI device reporting Android API 28 is available for development testing. The release report records actual tests; additional Fire sizes and operating-system versions remain to be checked.
draft: Entwicklungstests verwenden ein KFTRWI-Tablet mit Android-API 28. Der Bericht nennt tatsächliche Ergebnisse; weitere Fire-Größen und Betriebssystemversionen sind noch zu prüfen.

source: Voice varies by device

A microphone supports recording only when permission and hardware are available. Recognition and spoken feedback also need compatible installed services. Touch and text alternatives are always part of the design.
draft: Aufnahmen benötigen Berechtigung und Mikrofon. Spracherkennung und Vorlesen erfordern kompatible Dienste. Touch- und Texteingabe bleiben vorgesehen.

source: A journal that can feel like home
Choose a language or follow your device settings. Your stories are not translated.
draft: Wählen Sie eine Sprache oder die Geräteeinstellung. Ihre Geschichten werden nicht übersetzt.

source: The language plan
Targets include regional English, Spanish, French and Portuguese, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Japanese, Hindi, Arabic, Turkish, Indonesian, Korean and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
draft: Englisch, Spanisch, Französisch, Portugiesisch, Deutsch, Italienisch, Niederländisch, Polnisch, Schwedisch, Japanisch, Hindi, Arabisch, Türkisch, Indonesisch, Koreanisch sowie vereinfachtes und traditionelles Chinesisch.

source: Quality before a language claim

Translations must pass placeholder checks, layout tests and review. Store languages, app languages, distribution countries, speech recognition, spoken feedback and transcription each have separate support matrices.
draft: Übersetzungen brauchen Platzhalter-, Layout- und Sprachprüfung. App, Store, Länder und Sprachdienste haben jeweils eigene Unterstützungsmatrizen.

source: Your words stay yours
Changing the interface language does not translate personal memories or recordings. Unreviewed website translations are available in local preview only; production requires review.
draft: Ein Sprachwechsel übersetzt keine persönlichen Geschichten oder Aufnahmen. Ungeprüfte Website-Übersetzungen bleiben auf die lokale Vorschau beschränkt.

source: Keep the memories. Choose the extras.
Free: three albums, photographs, written stories, timeline and recordings up to three minutes. No limit on saved written memories.
draft: Kostenlos: drei Alben, Fotos, Geschichten, Zeitleiste und Aufnahmen bis drei Minuten. Die Anzahl gespeicherter geschriebener Erinnerungen ist unbegrenzt.

source: Free
Up to three albums, written memories, photographs, a timeline, scrapbook drafts and voice recordings up to three minutes. Saved written memories are not capped.
draft: Drei Alben, unbegrenzt viele geschriebene Erinnerungen, Fotos, Zeitleiste, Buchentwürfe und Aufnahmen bis drei Minuten.

source: LifeTalea Premium
One purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, keepsake PDF exports and encrypted local backups. Your existing memories always stay accessible.
draft: Ein Einmalkauf für unbegrenzte Alben, längere Aufnahmen, PDF-Export und verschlüsselte lokale Sicherungen. Vorhandene Erinnerungen bleiben zugänglich.

source: Your existing stories remain accessible
Premium availability does not lock you out of existing memories. Basic backup and restore remain available. Cloud transcription with ongoing costs is not included in a one-time price promise.
draft: Premium sperrt vorhandene Erinnerungen nicht. Grundlegende Sicherung und Wiederherstellung bleiben verfügbar. Cloud-Transkription mit laufenden Kosten wird nicht als Einmalkauf versprochen.

source: A few things worth knowing
Practical answers about privacy, recordings, family stories and local preservation.
draft: Praktische Antworten zu Datenschutz, Aufnahmen und dem Bewahren von Familiengeschichten.

source: Do I need an account?
Core local features require no LifeTalea account. Amazon purchasing uses the account and services provided by the Amazon Appstore.
draft: Lokale Funktionen benötigen kein LifeTalea-Konto. Käufe verwenden Konto und Dienste des Amazon Appstore.

source: How do I organise old photographs?
Begin with a small album and one photograph. Add names and context you know, use approximate dates when needed, and ask a relative about one detail at a time.
draft: Beginnen Sie mit einem kleinen Album und einem Foto. Ergänzen Sie bekannte Namen, Details und ungefähre Daten. Fragen Sie Angehörige jeweils nach einem Detail.

source: Can I record my parents’ life stories?
draft: Kann ich die Geschichten meiner Eltern aufnehmen?

source: Yes, with their permission and a compatible microphone. Start with a brief topic and check playback. Do not rely on a single device as your only copy.
draft: Ja, mit ihrer Zustimmung und einem kompatiblen Mikrofon. Beginnen Sie mit einem kurzen Thema und prüfen Sie die Wiedergabe. Bewahren Sie eine weitere Kopie auf.

source: Can I transcribe recordings?

Create a draft from this recording on your device. No audio is uploaded. Choose the spoken language, then confirm. Recordings up to ten minutes are supported. Processing may be slow; check the draft for mistakes before saving.
draft: Erstellen Sie auf Ihrem Gerät einen Textentwurf aus dieser Aufnahme. Es wird kein Audio hochgeladen. Wählen Sie die gesprochene Sprache und bestätigen Sie. Aufnahmen dürfen höchstens zehn Minuten lang sein. Die Verarbeitung kann dauern; prüfen Sie den Text vor dem Speichern.

source: Does LifeTalea sync between devices?
No cloud sync is implemented. Local archive export and restore are the preservation tools currently provided.
draft: Cloud-Synchronisierung ist nicht implementiert. Lokale Archive können exportiert und wiederhergestellt werden.

source: Privacy starts with where a story lives
draft: Datenschutz beginnt beim Speicherort Ihrer Geschichten

source: Development privacy notice from O.Bankole. Contact banksmi@mail.com. Legal review remains required before public release.
draft: Datenschutzhinweis zur Entwicklung von O.Bankole. Kontakt: banksmi@mail.com. Vor Veröffentlichung ist eine rechtliche Prüfung erforderlich.

source: Memories and media

Stories, transcripts, photographs, audio and scrapbook drafts stay in private app storage by default. LifeTalea does not require an account, collect location automatically or include advertising and analytics SDKs. Android automatic backup is disabled.
draft: Geschichten, Transkripte, Fotos, Audio und Entwürfe bleiben standardmäßig im privaten App-Speicher. LifeTalea benötigt kein Konto, erfasst keinen automatischen Standort und enthält keine Werbe- oder Analyse-SDKs. Android-Backup ist deaktiviert.

source: Choices that involve other services

Speech recognition uses your installed speech service, which may process speech over a network. It is activated only through push-to-talk with a disclosure. Amazon purchasing communicates with Amazon. Exporting to a cloud document provider shares the selected archive with that provider.

Amazon purchases send app-specific Amazon user and receipt identifiers to LifeTalea’s Supabase-hosted verifier and Amazon. Providers may retain request and connection logs. Stories, photos and recordings are not sent for verification. Saved-recording transcription runs on this device. Exported files must be deleted separately.

Optional daily reminder around 20:00 local time. Delivery may be delayed by device settings. Notifications contain no story content. Off by default.
draft:
Der installierte Sprachdienst kann Sprache online verarbeiten; die Aktivierung erfolgt ausdrücklich nach einem Hinweis. Käufe kommunizieren mit Amazon. Ein Cloud-Export übergibt dem Anbieter das gewählte Archiv.

Bei Amazon-Käufen werden die appbezogene Amazon-Nutzerkennung und Belegkennungen an den bei Supabase gehosteten Prüfdienst von LifeTalea und an Amazon gesendet. Die Anbieter können Anfrage- und Verbindungsprotokolle speichern. Geschichten, Fotos und Aufnahmen werden nicht zur Prüfung gesendet. Gespeicherte Aufnahmen werden auf diesem Gerät transkribiert. Exportierte Dateien müssen separat gelöscht werden.

Optional tägliche Erinnerung gegen 20 Uhr Ortszeit. Geräteeinstellungen können die Zustellung verzögern. Benachrichtigungen enthalten keine Geschichten. Standardmäßig deaktiviert.

source: Deletion and retention

You can delete individual memories and attachments or all local library data in Settings. Uninstalling removes local app data. Exported files are separate copies that you manage yourself. Purchase records are retained by Amazon under its policies.
draft: Löschen Sie einzelne Elemente oder die Bibliothek in den Einstellungen. Deinstallation entfernt lokale Daten. Exporte verwalten Sie separat; Amazon bewahrt Kaufdaten nach seinen Regeln auf.

source: Security limits

Private app storage relies on device protections; the local database does not have a separate application encryption key. Optional encrypted archives use a passphrase. There is no claim of end-to-end encryption or a completed legal compliance assessment.
draft: Privater Speicher nutzt den Geräteschutz; die lokale Datenbank hat keinen eigenen Anwendungsschlüssel. Archive können per Passphrase verschlüsselt werden. Ende-zu-Ende-Verschlüsselung und abgeschlossene Rechtskonformität werden nicht behauptet.

source: A little help with your next chapter
LifeTalea is in development. These steps cover the local tools currently implemented.
draft: LifeTalea wird entwickelt. Diese Hinweise betreffen die bereits implementierten lokalen Werkzeuge.

source: A recording will not start

Check microphone permission and free storage. Save the memory before attaching audio. If recognition is unavailable, use the written controls; speech commands and audio recording are separate capabilities.
draft: Prüfen Sie Mikrofonberechtigung und freien Speicher. Speichern Sie die Erinnerung vor dem Anhängen von Audio. Fehlt Spracherkennung, nutzen Sie die Schaltflächen; Aufnahme und Erkennung sind getrennt.

source: Keep a safe copy
Open Settings, choose whether to include photographs and audio, then Create backup. Store the archive somewhere safe. Restore validates the archive and shows a preview before importing.
draft: Wählen Sie in den Einstellungen Fotos und Audio für die Sicherung und speichern Sie das Archiv sicher. Die Wiederherstellung prüft das Archiv und zeigt vor dem Import eine Vorschau.

source: A PDF or archive will not save
draft: PDF oder Archiv lässt sich nicht speichern

source: Try a writable folder with enough free storage. Check that your chosen document provider is available. A failed export should leave source memories intact.
draft: Wählen Sie einen beschreibbaren Ordner mit ausreichend Speicher und prüfen Sie den Dokumentenanbieter. Ein Exportfehler sollte Originalerinnerungen unverändert lassen.

source: Get in touch
Contact O.Bankole for LifeTalea support at banksmi@mail.com.
draft: O.Bankole hilft bei Fragen zu LifeTalea unter banksmi@mail.com.

source: Protect your family’s privacy
When reporting an issue, describe the device, operating system, app version and steps. Avoid sending private stories, photographs, recordings or backup passphrases.
draft: Nennen Sie Gerät, Betriebssystem, App-Version und Schritte zum Problem. Senden Sie keine privaten Geschichten, Fotos, Aufnahmen oder Backup-Passphrasen.

Write to banksmi@mail.com.

source: A family memory journal gives context to photographs: who was there, what happened, and why the moment mattered.

source: Ask a small question
Instead of starting with a whole life story, ask about one meal, one journey or one place. A short answer is a valuable beginning. Let the storyteller choose what feels comfortable.
draft: Inizia da un pasto, un viaggio o un luogo. Anche una risposta breve è preziosa. Lascia che ciascuno scelga cosa raccontare.

source: Keep uncertainty honest
Old photographs rarely come with perfect dates. LifeTalea accepts a year, month, exact date or unknown date. You can add a location yourself without granting location access.
draft: LifeTalea accetta anno, mese, data precisa o sconosciuta. Puoi scrivere un luogo senza concedere l’accesso alla posizione.

draft: Un dispositivo può andare perso. Esporta un backup in un luogo che controlli e verificalo prima di eliminare l’originale.

source: Make room for their voice
Capture the pauses, laughter and familiar expressions that a written story cannot always hold.
draft: Conserva pause, risate ed espressioni familiari che un testo non sempre riesce a trasmettere.

source: Record with care
Ask the speaker’s permission. Find a quiet space and make a short test recording. Save a memory first, then choose Record a story. Pause or resume whenever you need.
draft: Chiedi il consenso e fai una prova in un luogo tranquillo. Salva prima il ricordo, poi registra. Puoi mettere in pausa e riprendere quando vuoi.

source: Check your tablet

draft: Servono un microfono funzionante e il relativo permesso. I comandi vocali dipendono da servizi installati, talvolta assenti sui tablet Fire. I controlli touch restano disponibili.

source: A written companion to a spoken memory

draft: Crea una bozza da questa registrazione sul tuo dispositivo. Nessun audio viene caricato. Scegli la lingua parlata e conferma. Sono supportate registrazioni fino a dieci minuti. L’elaborazione può essere lenta: controlla il testo prima di salvarlo.

source: What works today
Open a memory and edit its transcript field. You can type a transcript or paste text you already have. Corrections are stored locally beside the original recording.
draft: Apri un ricordo e digita o incolla la trascrizione. Le modifiche vengono conservate localmente accanto alla registrazione originale.

source: Review transcript draft
Transcribe recordings up to ten minutes long. Longer recordings are safe and can have a manually entered transcript.
draft: La trascrizione supporta registrazioni fino a dieci minuti. Quelle più lunghe restano salvate e possono essere trascritte manualmente.

Android speech recognition for commands is different from transcribing a saved recording. A device having one capability does not establish support for the other.

source: Remember how the chapters connect
draft: Ritrova il filo della tua storia

source: Explore saved memories in date order, including those with approximate and unknown dates.

source: Follow the years

draft: Le date note vanno dalla più recente alla più lontana, seguite dai racconti senza data. Cerca per testo, album o anno.

source: A date can change
Family research often reveals a new detail. Edit the event date and precision in the memory editor; the timeline uses the updated information.
draft: Una ricerca di famiglia può svelare nuovi dettagli. Modifica data e precisione nel ricordo per aggiornare la cronologia.

source: No invented history

draft: La cronologia usa solo ricordi salvati. LifeTalea non aggiunge eventi familiari inventati.

source: A keepsake to hold onto
draft: Un libro dei ricordi da conservare

source: Create a local PDF from a scrapbook’s selected memories, photographs and captions.
draft: Crea un PDF locale con ricordi, fotografie e didascalie scelti per il libro.

source: Choose what to include

draft: Aggiungi un titolo di copertina e scegli A4 o Letter. Luoghi e trascrizioni sono esclusi per impostazione predefinita; puoi includerli.

source: Review before sharing

PDFs are generated on the device through Android’s PDF API. Long stories continue onto extra pages. Audio is not embedded in printed keepsakes. Review typography and photographs in your PDF viewer before printing.
draft: Il PDF viene generato sul dispositivo con Android. I racconti lunghi continuano su altre pagine; l’audio non è incluso. Controlla testo e foto prima di stampare.

source: Development status
This feature requires LifeTalea Premium. PDF generation happens on your device. Review the file before sharing. Recordings are not embedded in printed keepsakes.
draft: Questa caratteristica richiede LifeTalea Premium. Il PDF viene creato sul dispositivo. Controllalo prima di condividerlo. Le registrazioni audio non sono incluse nei libri stampati.

source: Your memories, even without a connection
draft: I tuoi ricordi, anche senza connessione

source: LifeTalea is designed around local storage and touch controls, without a mandatory account.
draft: LifeTalea privilegia dati locali e comandi touch, senza un account obbligatorio.

source: Keep creating offline

draft: Racconti, album, foto importate, registrazioni, cronologia e bozze usano dati locali. Creare PDF non richiede un servizio esterno.

source: Know the boundaries

Push to talk uses your device’s speech service, which may need internet and process speech externally. Only continue if you agree. Audio commands are not saved by LifeTalea. Command phrases currently support English. Create a draft from this recording on your device. No audio is uploaded. Choose the spoken language, then confirm. Recordings up to ten minutes are supported. Processing may be slow; check the draft for mistakes before saving.
draft: La funzione premi per parlare usa il servizio vocale del dispositivo, che potrebbe richiedere Internet ed elaborare la voce al di fuori del dispositivo. Continua solo se acconsenti. LifeTalea non salva l’audio dei comandi. Al momento i comandi sono supportati solo in inglese. Crea una bozza da questa registrazione sul tuo dispositivo. Nessun audio viene caricato. Scegli la lingua parlata e conferma. Sono supportate registrazioni fino a dieci minuti. L’elaborazione può essere lenta: controlla il testo prima di salvarlo.

source: Backups are your choice
Use the document picker to save an archive where you choose. If you select a cloud-backed document provider, that provider handles the exported file under its own privacy terms.
draft: Scegli la destinazione del backup. Se usi un fornitore di documenti cloud, il file esportato sarà gestito secondo le sue regole di privacy.

source: Built with Fire tablets in mind
A native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose application with no required Google Play Services.
draft: Un’app nativa in Kotlin e Jetpack Compose, senza servizi Google Play obbligatori.

draft: L’API Android minima è 26: non significa che tutti i dispositivi siano certificati. La navigazione con telecomando Fire TV è fuori dall’ambito attuale.

source: Device testing

A connected KFTRWI device reporting Android API 28 is available for development testing. The release report records actual tests; additional Fire sizes and operating-system versions remain to be checked.
draft: I test di sviluppo usano un tablet KFTRWI con API Android 28. Il rapporto documenta i risultati reali; altre dimensioni e versioni Fire restano da verificare.

source: Voice varies by device

A microphone supports recording only when permission and hardware are available. Recognition and spoken feedback also need compatible installed services. Touch and text alternatives are always part of the design.
draft: La registrazione richiede microfono e permesso. Riconoscimento e lettura vocale necessitano di servizi compatibili. Sono previste alternative touch e testuali.

source: A journal that can feel like home
Choose a language or follow your device settings. Your stories are not translated.
draft: Scegli una lingua o usa quella del dispositivo. I tuoi racconti non vengono tradotti.

draft: Inglese, spagnolo, francese, portoghese, tedesco, italiano, neerlandese, polacco, svedese, giapponese, hindi, arabo, turco, indonesiano, coreano e cinese semplificato e tradizionale.

source: Quality before a language claim

Translations must pass placeholder checks, layout tests and review. Store languages, app languages, distribution countries, speech recognition, spoken feedback and transcription each have separate support matrices.
draft: Le traduzioni richiedono controlli di variabili, layout e lingua. App, store, paesi e servizi vocali hanno ciascuno un proprio ambito di supporto.

source: Your words stay yours

draft: Cambiare lingua non traduce racconti o registrazioni personali. Le traduzioni web non revisionate sono disponibili solo nell’anteprima locale.

source: Keep the memories. Choose the extras.
draft: Conserva i ricordi. Scegli gli extra.

draft: Gratis: tre album, foto, racconti, cronologia e registrazioni fino a tre minuti. Nessun limite al numero di ricordi scritti salvati.

source: Free
Up to three albums, written memories, photographs, a timeline, scrapbook drafts and voice recordings up to three minutes. Saved written memories are not capped.
draft: Tre album, racconti scritti senza limite di numero, foto, cronologia, bozze di libri e registrazioni fino a tre minuti.

One purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, keepsake PDF exports and encrypted local backups. Your existing memories always stay accessible.
draft: Un acquisto unico per album illimitati, registrazioni più lunghe, esportazione PDF e backup locali cifrati. I ricordi esistenti restano accessibili.

source: Your existing stories remain accessible
Premium availability does not lock you out of existing memories. Basic backup and restore remain available. Cloud transcription with ongoing costs is not included in a one-time price promise.
draft: La disponibilità di Premium non blocca i ricordi esistenti. Backup e ripristino di base restano disponibili. Non si promette trascrizione cloud con costi ricorrenti.

draft: Informazioni pratiche su privacy, registrazioni e conservazione delle storie di famiglia.

Core local features require no LifeTalea account. Amazon purchasing uses the account and services provided by the Amazon Appstore.
draft: Le funzioni locali non richiedono un account LifeTalea. Gli acquisti usano account e servizi di Amazon Appstore.

Begin with a small album and one photograph. Add names and context you know, use approximate dates when needed, and ask a relative about one detail at a time.
draft: Inizia da un piccolo album e una foto. Aggiungi nomi, dettagli noti e date approssimative. Chiedi ai familiari un dettaglio alla volta.

draft: Posso registrare le storie dei miei genitori?

draft: Sì, con il loro consenso e un microfono compatibile. Scegli un argomento breve e controlla la riproduzione. Conserva una copia anche altrove.

Create a draft from this recording on your device. No audio is uploaded. Choose the spoken language, then confirm. Recordings up to ten minutes are supported. Processing may be slow; check the draft for mistakes before saving.
draft: Crea una bozza da questa registrazione sul tuo dispositivo. Nessun audio viene caricato. Scegli la lingua parlata e conferma. Sono supportate registrazioni fino a dieci minuti. L’elaborazione può essere lenta: controlla il testo prima di salvarlo.

No cloud sync is implemented. Local archive export and restore are the preservation tools currently provided.
draft: La sincronizzazione cloud non è implementata. Puoi esportare e ripristinare archivi locali.

source: Privacy starts with where a story lives
draft: La privacy inizia da dove vivono le storie

source: Memories and media

Stories, transcripts, photographs, audio and scrapbook drafts stay in private app storage by default. LifeTalea does not require an account, collect location automatically or include advertising and analytics SDKs. Android automatic backup is disabled.
draft: Racconti, trascrizioni, foto, audio e bozze restano per impostazione predefinita nello spazio privato dell’app. LifeTalea non richiede account, non raccoglie automaticamente la posizione e non include SDK pubblicitari o analitici. Il backup Android è disattivato.

source: Choices that involve other services

Speech recognition uses your installed speech service, which may process speech over a network. It is activated only through push-to-talk with a disclosure. Amazon purchasing communicates with Amazon. Exporting to a cloud document provider shares the selected archive with that provider.

Amazon purchases send app-specific Amazon user and receipt identifiers to LifeTalea’s Supabase-hosted verifier and Amazon. Providers may retain request and connection logs. Stories, photos and recordings are not sent for verification. Saved-recording transcription runs on this device. Exported files must be deleted separately.

Optional daily reminder around 20:00 local time. Delivery may be delayed by device settings. Notifications contain no story content. Off by default.
draft:
Il servizio vocale installato può elaborare la voce online, dopo attivazione esplicita con informativa. Gli acquisti comunicano con Amazon. Esportare nel cloud consegna l’archivio al fornitore scelto.

Gli acquisti Amazon inviano l’identificativo utente Amazon specifico dell’app e gli identificativi delle ricevute al servizio di verifica di LifeTalea ospitato su Supabase e ad Amazon. I fornitori possono conservare registri delle richieste e delle connessioni. Storie, foto e registrazioni non vengono inviate per la verifica. Le registrazioni vengono trascritte su questo dispositivo. I file esportati devono essere eliminati separatamente.

Promemoria giornaliero facoltativo verso le 20:00, ora locale. Le impostazioni del dispositivo possono ritardarlo. Le notifiche non contengono storie. Disattivato per impostazione predefinita.

source: Deletion and retention

You can delete individual memories and attachments or all local library data in Settings. Uninstalling removes local app data. Exported files are separate copies that you manage yourself. Purchase records are retained by Amazon under its policies.
draft: Puoi eliminare singoli elementi o la raccolta dalle impostazioni. Disinstallare rimuove i dati locali. Gestisci separatamente gli export; Amazon conserva i dati di acquisto secondo le proprie regole.

source: Security limits

Private app storage relies on device protections; the local database does not have a separate application encryption key. Optional encrypted archives use a passphrase. There is no claim of end-to-end encryption or a completed legal compliance assessment.
draft: Lo spazio privato dipende dalle protezioni del dispositivo; il database locale non ha una chiave di cifratura propria. Gli archivi possono essere cifrati con una passphrase. Non si dichiara cifratura end-to-end né una valutazione legale completa.

draft: Nelle impostazioni scegli se includere foto e audio, poi crea il backup. Conservalo al sicuro. Il ripristino verifica l’archivio e mostra un’anteprima prima di importare.

draft: Relatos, transcrições, fotos, áudio e rascunhos ficam no armazenamento privado por padrão. O LifeTalea não exige conta, não coleta localização automaticamente nem inclui SDKs de publicidade ou análise. A cópia automática do Android está desativada.

source: Choices that involve other services

Speech recognition uses your installed speech service, which may process speech over a network. It is activated only through push-to-talk with a disclosure. Amazon purchasing communicates with Amazon. Exporting to a cloud document provider shares the selected archive with that provider.

Amazon purchases send app-specific Amazon user and receipt identifiers to LifeTalea’s Supabase-hosted verifier and Amazon. Providers may retain request and connection logs. Stories, photos and recordings are not sent for verification. Saved-recording transcription runs on this device. Exported files must be deleted separately.

Optional daily reminder around 20:00 local time. Delivery may be delayed by device settings. Notifications contain no story content. Off by default.
draft:
O serviço de voz instalado pode processar áudio pela rede, após ativação explícita com aviso. Compras se comunicam com a Amazon. Exportar para a nuvem entrega o arquivo escolhido ao provedor.

As compras na Amazon enviam o identificador de usuário da Amazon específico do aplicativo e os identificadores dos recibos ao serviço de verificação do LifeTalea hospedado no Supabase e à Amazon. Os fornecedores podem manter registros de solicitações e conexões. Histórias, fotos e gravações não são enviadas para verificação. As gravações são transcritas neste dispositivo. Lembrete diário opcional por volta das 20h, no horário local. As configurações do dispositivo podem atrasar a entrega. As notificações não contêm histórias. Desativado por padrão.

source: Deletion and retention

परिवार की तस्वीरों, आवाज़ों और कहानियों के लिए एक निजी जगह।

शीर्षक, कुछ पंक्तियाँ और सटीक, अनुमानित या अज्ञात तारीख जोड़ें। टैग, पसंदीदा और एल्बम से कहानी फिर खोजें।

डिवाइस के फ़ाइल चयन से तस्वीरें लाएँ और कहानी रिकॉर्ड करें। फ़ाइलें ऐप के निजी स्टोरेज में कॉपी होती हैं।

रिकॉर्डिंग इसी डिवाइस पर रहती है। ऐप से बाहर जाने पर रिकॉर्डिंग रुककर सेव हो जाती है। मुफ़्त रिकॉर्डिंग अधिकतम तीन मिनट की हो सकती है।

इस रिकॉर्डिंग से अपने डिवाइस पर पाठ का मसौदा बनाएं। कोई ऑडियो अपलोड नहीं होता। बोली गई भाषा चुनें और पुष्टि करें। दस मिनट तक की रिकॉर्डिंग समर्थित हैं। प्रक्रिया धीमी हो सकती है; सहेजने से पहले पाठ की जाँच करें।

बोलने के लिए दबाने की सुविधा आपके डिवाइस की वाक् सेवा का उपयोग करती है। इस सेवा को इंटरनेट की आवश्यकता हो सकती है और यह डिवाइस के बाहर आवाज़ को संसाधित कर सकती है। सहमत होने पर ही आगे बढ़ें। LifeTalea आवाज़ वाले आदेशों की रिकॉर्डिंग नहीं सहेजता। फ़िलहाल आदेश केवल अंग्रेज़ी में उपलब्ध हैं।

एकमुश्त खरीद से असीमित एल्बम, लंबी रिकॉर्डिंग, PDF निर्यात और एन्क्रिप्टेड लोकल बैकअप पाएँ। मौजूदा यादें उपलब्ध रहती हैं।

कहानियाँ, प्रतिलिपियाँ, एल्बम और किताबों के मसौदे शामिल हैं। फ़ोटो और रिकॉर्डिंग केवल आपके चुनने पर शामिल की जाती हैं। बिना एन्क्रिप्शन के निर्यात में निजी जानकारी पढ़ी जा सकती है। अपना पासफ़्रेज़ सुरक्षित रखें; उसे वापस नहीं पाया जा सकता। मौजूदा सीमा: हर संग्रह के लिए 32 MiB और हर संलग्न फ़ाइल के लिए 16 MiB। बड़ी लाइब्रेरी के लिए भविष्य का संस्करण चाहिए।

Amazon खरीदारी के दौरान ऐप के लिए विशिष्ट Amazon उपयोगकर्ता और रसीद पहचानकर्ता Supabase पर होस्ट की गई LifeTalea सत्यापन सेवा और Amazon को भेजे जाते हैं। सेवा प्रदाता अनुरोध और कनेक्शन लॉग रख सकते हैं। सत्यापन के लिए कहानियाँ, फ़ोटो या रिकॉर्डिंग नहीं भेजी जातीं। सहेजी गई रिकॉर्डिंग का प्रतिलेखन इसी डिवाइस पर होता है। निर्यात की गई फ़ाइलें अलग से मिटानी होंगी।

स्थानीय समयानुसार रोज़ लगभग 20:00 बजे वैकल्पिक अनुस्मारक। डिवाइस की सेटिंग के कारण सूचना देर से आ सकती है। सूचनाओं में कहानी की सामग्री नहीं होती। डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से बंद है।

ऐप से बाहर जाने के बाद LifeTalea खोलने के लिए डिवाइस के स्क्रीन लॉक का उपयोग करें। पहले डिवाइस पर स्क्रीन लॉक सेट करें। निर्यात की गई फ़ाइलें अलग रहती हैं।

تتضمن النسخة القصص والنصوص المكتوبة للتسجيلات والألبومات ومسودات كتب الذكريات. تُضمّن الصور والتسجيلات فقط عند اختيارها. تحتوي النسخ المصدّرة غير المشفّرة على معلومات خاصة قابلة للقراءة. احتفظ بعبارة المرور، إذ لا يمكن استعادتها. الحدود الحالية: 32 MiB لكل أرشيف و16 MiB لكل مرفق. تحتاج المكتبات الأكبر إلى إصدار مستقبلي.

draft:
Anları koruyun. Sesleri hatırlayın.

Fotoğraflar, sesler ve aile hikâyeleri için özel bir alan.

Başlık, birkaç satır ve kesin, yaklaşık ya da bilinmeyen bir tarih ekleyin. Hikâyeleri etiketler, favoriler ve albümlerle bulun.

Belge seçiciyle fotoğraf alın ve sesli hikâye kaydedin. Dosyalar uygulamanın özel depolama alanına kopyalanır.

Kayıt bu cihazda kalır. Uygulamadan çıktığınızda kayıt durdurulur ve kaydedilir. Ücretsiz kayıtlar en fazla üç dakika olabilir.

Bu kayıttan cihazınızda bir metin taslağı oluşturun. Ses yüklenmez. Konuşulan dili seçip onaylayın. En fazla on dakikalık kayıtlar desteklenir. İşlem yavaş olabilir; kaydetmeden önce metni kontrol edin.

Bas konuş özelliği cihazınızın konuşma hizmetini kullanır. Bu hizmet internete ihtiyaç duyabilir ve konuşmayı cihaz dışında işleyebilir. Yalnızca kabul ediyorsanız devam edin. LifeTalea sesli komut kayıtlarını saklamaz. Komutlar şu anda yalnızca İngilizce olarak desteklenmektedir.

Sınırsız albüm, uzun kayıtlar, PDF dışa aktarma ve şifreli yerel yedekler için tek seferlik satın alım. Mevcut anılarınız erişilebilir kalır.

Hikâyeler, konuşma metinleri, albümler ve kitap taslakları dahildir. Fotoğraf ve kayıtlar yalnızca seçildiğinde eklenir. Şifrelenmemiş dışa aktarmalar okunabilir özel bilgiler içerir. Parolanızı güvenli saklayın; geri alınamaz. Güncel sınırlar: arşiv başına 32 MiB ve ek başına 16 MiB. Daha büyük kitaplıklar için gelecekteki bir sürüm gereklidir.

Amazon satın alımları, uygulamaya özel Amazon kullanıcı kimliğini ve makbuz kimliklerini Supabase üzerinde barındırılan LifeTalea doğrulama hizmetine ve Amazon’a gönderir. Sağlayıcılar istek ve bağlantı günlüklerini saklayabilir. Hikâyeler, fotoğraflar ve kayıtlar doğrulama için gönderilmez. Kayıtların dökümü bu cihazda oluşturulur. Dışa aktarılan dosyalar ayrıca silinmelidir.

Yerel saatle 20.00 civarında isteğe bağlı günlük hatırlatıcı. Cihaz ayarları bildirimi geciktirebilir. Bildirimler hikâye içeriği içermez. Varsayılan olarak kapalıdır.

Uygulamadan çıktıktan sonra LifeTalea’yı açmak için cihazınızın ekran kilidini kullanın. Önce cihazda ekran kilidi ayarlayın. Dışa aktarılan dosyalar ayrı tutulur.

source: Memories and media

Stories, transcripts, photographs, audio and scrapbook drafts stay in private app storage by default. LifeTalea does not require an account, collect location automatically or include advertising and analytics SDKs. Android automatic backup is disabled.
draft: Cerita, transkrip, foto, audio, dan draf secara bawaan berada di penyimpanan pribadi. LifeTalea tidak mewajibkan akun, tidak mengumpulkan lokasi secara otomatis, dan tidak menyertakan SDK iklan atau analitik. Cadangan Android dinonaktifkan.

source: Choices that involve other services

Speech recognition uses your installed speech service, which may process speech over a network. It is activated only through push-to-talk with a disclosure. Amazon purchasing communicates with Amazon. Exporting to a cloud document provider shares the selected archive with that provider.

Amazon purchases send app-specific Amazon user and receipt identifiers to LifeTalea’s Supabase-hosted verifier and Amazon. Providers may retain request and connection logs. Stories, photos and recordings are not sent for verification. Saved-recording transcription runs on this device. Exported files must be deleted separately.

Optional daily reminder around 20:00 local time. Delivery may be delayed by device settings. Notifications contain no story content. Off by default.

Pembelian Amazon mengirim ID pengguna Amazon khusus aplikasi dan ID tanda terima ke layanan verifikasi LifeTalea yang dihosting di Supabase serta ke Amazon. source: Deletion and retention

You can delete individual memories and attachments or all local library data in Settings. Uninstalling removes local app data. Exported files are separate copies that you manage yourself. Purchase records are retained by Amazon under its policies.

source: Security limits

Private app storage relies on device protections; the local database does not have a separate application encryption key. Optional encrypted archives use a passphrase. There is no claim of end-to-end encryption or a completed legal compliance assessment.

source: Deletion and retention

You can delete individual memories and attachments or all local library data in Settings. Uninstalling removes local app data. Exported files are separate copies that you manage yourself. Purchase records are retained by Amazon under its policies.
draft: 可在設定中刪除單項內容或整個資料庫。卸載會刪除本地應用程式資料。匯出檔案需另行管理；Amazon按其政策保留購買記錄。

source: Security limits

Private app storage relies on device protections; the local database does not have a separate application encryption key. Optional encrypted archives use a passphrase. There is no claim of end-to-end encryption or a completed legal compliance assessment.
draft: 私有儲存依賴裝置防護；本地資料庫沒有獨立的應用程式加密密鑰。歸檔可用通關密語加密。不宣稱端到端加密，也不宣稱已完成法律合規評估。

source: A little help with your next chapter
LifeTalea is in development. These steps cover the local tools currently implemented.
draft: LifeTalea仍在開發中。以下指引適用於已經實現的本地工具。

source: A recording will not start

Check microphone permission and free storage. Save the memory before attaching audio. If recognition is unavailable, use the written controls; speech commands and audio recording are separate capabilities.
draft: 檢查麥克風權限和空餘空間。附加音訊前先儲存回憶。沒有語音識別時可使用按鈕；識別與錄音是不同功能。

source: Keep a safe copy
Open Settings, choose whether to include photographs and audio, then Create backup. Store the archive somewhere safe. Restore validates the archive and shows a preview before importing.
draft: 在設定中選擇是否包含照片和音訊，然後建立備份並妥善儲存。恢復時會驗證歸檔，並在匯入前顯示預覽。

source: A PDF or archive will not save
Try a writable folder with enough free storage. Check that your chosen document provider is available. A failed export should leave source memories intact.
draft: 請選擇可寫入且空間充足的資料夾，並檢查文件服務是否可用。匯出失敗不應改變原始回憶。

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

A private place for photographs, voices and family stories.

Write a title and a few lines. Add an exact date, an approximate year or no date at all. Tags, favourites and albums help you find the story again.

Import photographs using your device’s document picker. Record a voice story and keep it beside the written memory. Media is copied into private app storage.

Audio stays on this device. Leaving the app stops and saves this recording. Free recordings are limited to three minutes.

Create a draft from this recording on your device. No audio is uploaded. Choose the spoken language, then confirm. Recordings up to ten minutes are supported. Processing may be slow; check the draft for mistakes before saving.

Push to talk uses your device’s speech service, which may need internet and process speech externally. Only continue if you agree. Audio commands are not saved by LifeTalea. Command phrases currently support English.

One purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, keepsake PDF exports and encrypted local backups. Your existing memories always stay accessible.

Stories, transcripts, albums and scrapbook drafts are included. Photos and recordings are included only when selected. Unencrypted exports contain readable private information. Keep your passphrase safe; it cannot be recovered. Current archive limits: 32 MiB total and 16 MiB per attachment. Larger libraries need a future streaming backup implementation.

Amazon purchases send app-specific Amazon user and receipt identifiers to LifeTalea’s Supabase-hosted verifier and Amazon. Providers may retain request and connection logs. Stories, photos and recordings are not sent for verification. Saved-recording transcription runs on this device. Exported files must be deleted separately.

Optional daily reminder around 20:00 local time. Delivery may be delayed by device settings. Notifications contain no story content. Off by default.

Use your device screen lock to unlock LifeTalea after leaving the app. Set up a device screen lock first. Exported files are separate.

珍藏時光，留住聲音。

爲家庭照片、熟悉的聲音和珍貴的故事，留一處私密空間。

寫下標題和故事，選擇準確、大致或未知日期。用標籤、收藏和相簿找回回憶。

通過裝置的檔案選擇器匯入照片，也可以錄下故事。檔案會複製到應用程式的私有儲存空間。

錄音儲存在此裝置上。離開應用時，錄音會停止並儲存。免費版每段錄音最長三分鐘。

根據此錄音在裝置上產生文字草稿。不會上傳任何音訊。請選擇錄音中使用的語言，再按確認。支援最長十分鐘的錄音。處理可能較慢，儲存前請檢查文字是否有誤。

按住說話功能使用設備的語音服務。該服務可能需要互聯網連接，並在設備外部處理語音。僅在同意的情況下繼續。LifeTalea 不保存語音命令的錄音。目前僅支持英語命令。

一次購買，即可使用不限數量的相簿、更長錄音、PDF導出和加密本地備份。現有回憶始終可讀。

備份包含故事、逐字稿、相簿和回憶冊草稿。照片和錄音只會在您選取後加入。未加密的匯出檔案包含可讀取的私人資訊。請妥善保管通關密語，遺失後無法找回。目前每個備份檔總大小上限為 32 MiB，每個附件上限為 16 MiB。更大的資料庫需等待未來版本支援。

離開應用程式後，使用裝置的螢幕鎖定功能解鎖 LifeTalea。請先在裝置上設定螢幕鎖定。匯出的檔案需另外管理。
